When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

movies.title: The History of Concrete
movies.overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

movies.title: Volta
movies.overview: A group of young activists orchestrate an unlikely and high-risk operation to force the CEO of a major bank to question his convictions.

movies.title: Daayra
movies.overview: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

movies.title: On the Road
movies.overview: Veneno, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets Muñeco, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk.

movies.title: The Infinite
movies.overview: Charlie Donovan, on the brink of losing everything he loves, is drawn into a fateful journey with seven strange strangers, each of whom holds a key to save him from self-destruction.

movies.title: Cabaret Boys
movies.overview: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

movies.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
movies.overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

movies.title: White Lightning
movies.overview: WHITE LIGHTNING is a gritty, funny, and uniquely American story about second chances, legacy, and what it takes to outrun your past. This feature-length documentary follows 18-year-old sprinter King Combest as he attempts to break his father’s 25-year-old national high school record–and the cycle of drugs, jail, and poverty that has shaped his Kentucky family for generations. King’s father Casey (aka “White Lightning”) was once an elite sprinter destined for Olympic greatness before a marijuana arrest derailed his career and left him working as a janitor on the margins of society. As King chases his father’s iconic record, it becomes clear that the real stakes are far greater: becoming the first man in the Combest family to earn a college degree and forging a path beyond a legacy of crime and addiction.

movies.title: You Can't Leave
movies.overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

movies.title: Never After Dark
movies.overview: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

movies.title: Double Trouble
movies.overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
movies.overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

movies.title: Her Song
movies.overview: Olivia, a Franco-American writer, returns to her ancestral village in the south of France to write the story of her grandmother, who fled Paris during the Nazi invasion during World War II. There, she meets Madeline, a talented local artist, who quickly replaces her grandmother as the face of the novel. As a number of strange coincidences ensue, fiction and reality intermingle uncannily, and Olivia starts to ask whether she's part of history's unfolding story, or vice-versa.

movies.title: Making Marie Antoinette
movies.overview: Eleanor Coppola's behind-the-scenes documentation of her daughter Sofia Coppola directing the 2006 film Marie Antoinette, capturing the craftsmanship and challenges of being a young female director.

movies.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
movies.overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

movies.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
movies.overview: A cop tries to track down Bikram Pramanik, a master of disguise whose wife is a pickpocket.

movies.title: La jangada
movies.overview: La Jangada is the union of 35 musicians embraced by nature with a common goal: to bring to life songs that are born from the heart of this country.  In search of the vastness that these songs convey, we wanted to bring a piece of Santiago del Estero's land straight to the Río de La Plata.

movies.title: Deathgasm II: Goremageddon
movies.overview: After failing to reform his heavy metal band DEATHGASM for a battle-of-the-bands to win back his girlfriend Medina, Brodie decides to use black magic to raise his ex-band members Zakk and Dion from the dead. However, his resurrected friends become unpredictable and dangerous, leading to chaos in the town.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

movies.title: Penance
movies.overview: While traveling through an unsafe land, a Soldier and a Princess take shelter in a seemingly empty cavern.

movies.title: Nickels
movies.overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

movies.title: Drury Lane
movies.overview: A flat tire leaves realtor James stranded on the side of the road. He’s now at the mercy of a stranger who finds himself on the same road, on the same night, at the same time…
movies.director: Mauricio Antonio Morazan, Jared Adler Gomez

movies.title: The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World
movies.overview: This epic documentary reveals how bold artistic choices, behind-the-scenes conflicts, and groundbreaking ideas came together to create an enduring television classic. Through exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, The Sixty-Year Mission uncovers that truth is indeed stranger than science-fiction.

movies.title: Falling
movies.overview: Alone in the suffocating quiet of his surrogate sister’s apartment, fifteen-year-old Analu clings desperately to memories of his lost loved one, Iolani, the one person who made him feel seen. The night becomes a battleground of haunting flashbacks and quiet suffering, as Analu teeters between holding on and letting go. Malu, his surrogate sister, fights to reach the part of him still holding on. Falling is a raw, intimate journey through trauma, where the weight of the past threatens to eclipse the connections that remain.

movies.title: Begotten
movies.overview: Begotten is the creation myth brought to life, the story of no less than the violent death of God and the (re)birth of nature on a barren earth.

movies.title: The Deputy
movies.overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

movies.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
movies.overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

movies.title: The Sickling
movies.overview: After surviving a lifetime of debilitating pain caused by sickle cell disease, Gabriel Badejo takes the greatest risk of his life by undergoing an experimental stem cell transplant in hopes of a cure. The Sickling follows Gabriel’s emotional and physical journey as he confronts systemic racism in healthcare, painful memories of medical neglect, and the global realities of living with an often invisible disease. From Toronto to Nigeria, the film explores the intersections of illness, identity, family, and survival while uncovering the historical inequities that continue to shape sickle cell care worldwide. At its heart, The Sickling is a deeply personal story about healing, resilience, and the fight to reclaim a future once thought impossible.

movies.title: Optimus Prime Awakening
movies.overview: An animated epilogue to The Transformers: The Movie (1986) and the final performance of Peter Cullen.

movies.title: The Stunt Driver
movies.overview: Based on a true story, a Canadian stunt driver recruits a top sports manager and rocket car designers to attempt a record-breaking jump across the Saint Lawrence River, hoping to achieve fame and fortune.

movies.title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
movies.overview: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

movies.title: Vibe
movies.overview: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

movies.title: Thread Bound
movies.overview: When a skeptical teen meets a mysterious boy with a healing gift, they begin a journey to unravel the painful threads of their past, and discover that something greater may be connecting it all.

movies.title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
movies.overview: Natalie prepares for the launch of her debut children’s book, Adeline the Angel, while Wes continues to deepen his faith journey. When Caroline quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, the family discovers that some of God’s greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness. As Christmas approaches, Bellford Falls once again becomes a place where hope is restored, prayers are answered, and hearts are drawn closer to the reason for the season.

movies.title: Comrade Kalyan
movies.overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

movies.title: Banshee
movies.overview: An Irish folk horror short filmed in Donegal, Ireland.

movies.title: It's How It Ends

movies.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
movies.overview: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

movies.title: Anbil Avan

movies.title: Mendocino

movies.overview: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

movies.overview: In New Zealand, a Tongan father in his seventies labours through the unchanging rhythm of construction work, long after his children have grown and moved on. movies.title: ENVY
movies.overview: When Molly, a timid freshman ballerina, befriends Alison, an older girl in her class, the line between adoration and obsession starts to blur.

movies.title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
movies.overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.

movies.title: The Vampires of New Orleans
movies.overview: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.

movies.overview: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

movies.overview: A person tries to find their missing sentient cigarette as three narrators express frustrations.

movies.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
movies.overview: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. movies.title: Going for Two
movies.overview: In the fall of 1983, as their beloved college football team vies for the National Championship, a fatherless 12-year-old boy and his tomboy neighbor embark on a quest for his 'manhood'.

movies.title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
movies.overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

movies.title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
movies.overview: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

movies.overview: Lisa has come home from a disappointing evening, feeling forlorn and friendless. What Lisa doesn't realize is someone is there waiting for her.

They encounter a sinister presence far more frightening - and deadlier - than specters and staged scares: Tickles and his caretaker brother Bull. One by one, the investigators, together with local thrill-seekers, fall victim!

movies.title: Denial
movies.overview: A young man struggles with Bipolar Disorder as he begins a new job and flirtation.

movies.title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
movies.overview: “Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness” is a feature documentary that explores all the major psychedelics, not just by explaining how they work medicinally, but by taking viewers inside dosing rooms for extremely rare looks at the remarkable power, emotion, and speed of psychedelic healing in action: from pro athletes repairing brain damage from concussions, to combat veterans finding relief from suicidal despair, to a woman breaking free from opioid addiction, to survivors of the Nova Music Festival massacre who say being on psychedelics during the attack shielded them from developing mental trauma.

movies.title: Avaraachan & Sons
movies.overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

movies.title: Gran Blanco
movies.overview: A portrait of an American tourist in Mexico.

movies.title: Thella Kaagitham
movies.overview: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

movies.title: Kikuyu Land
movies.overview: As a Nairobi journalist probes a land battle entangling the local government and a powerful multinational corporation, covered wounds are revealed and family secrets are exposed.

movies.title: JINX
movies.overview: A married couple discovers how dangerous it is to be too much like your partner.

movies.title: Dirty Laundry
movies.overview: A writer faces the reality of life after college.

movies.title: The Eyes of Ghana
movies.overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

movies.title: Union County
movies.overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

movies.title: The Metropolitan Opera: Macbeth
movies.overview: Two of opera’s most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi’s thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost. Following past triumphs in many of Verdi’s signature baritone roles, Quinn Kelsey is the Scottish king haunted by the ghosts of his murderous ascent to the throne, opposite Lise Davidsen—the world’s reigning dramatic soprano—as the power-mad Lady Macbeth, whose ruinous ambition damns them both. Met Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin takes the podium for a penetrating production by Louisa Proske, a brilliant young director making waves around the world. Rounding out the all-star cast are tenor Freddie De Tommaso as the heroic Macduff and bass-baritone Ryan Speedo Green as Macbeth’s friend-turned-victim Banquo. This live cinema transmission is part of The Met: Live in HD series, bringing opera to movie theaters across the globe.

movies.title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
movies.overview: When love becomes an obsession, the line between devotion and danger begins to blur.

movies.title: FAM-ILLI

movies.title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
movies.overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

movies.title: Winter of the Crow

Taxis are replaced by tanks, citizens are treated like criminals, and visiting British Professor Joan Andrews finds herself trapped. After witnessing the murder of a young student by the secret police, Joan herself becomes the target.

movies.title: Camp Duval
movies.overview: Welcome to Camp Duval, the wildest comedy camp ever created — where rising comics come to sharpen their jokes, survive the chaos, and hopefully make it through the night.

As Israel's intelligence agency interrogates him, Dov will retell and re-adjust the story of taking matters into his own hands, as he is adamant to prove he is still worth something in this world.

movies.title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
movies.overview: On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset, and work ethic that made him one of the most legendary artists of his time.

movies.title: Cuppa' Joe
movies.overview: Beneath the canned laughter of a 1950s sitcom, an Asian-Native Hawaiian couple navigates a dystopian allegory of diaspora, identity, and the cost of belonging in America.

movies.title: The Condor Daughter

movies.title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical

movies.title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match

movies.title: Heaven in Stone and Glass

movies.title: Stone Glass Metal

movies.title: The Jesus Tapes

movies.title: Dead Wife Cult

movies.title: The Flesh of the Mountain
movies.overview: The ragged, desolate landscapes around eastern California’s Owens Lake are rendered in negative monochrome in the latest entry in Adam Piron’s film cycle about the brutal history of Indigenous land expropriation in the American West. movies.title: Dasher

Set in urban Honolulu, DASHER is a local take on what’s likely a nationwide story for young people living the gig economy – where working long hours just to get by discourages any life beyond the next gig.

movies.title: The Trinitarians

movies.title: Where Do Black Men Live?
movies.overview: Where Do Black Men Live? explores the experiences of low-income and housing-insecure Black men in Cambridge, Massachusetts, amplifying voices too often excluded from conversations about housing, urban policy, and racial justice. Produced by The Black Response and based on 25 ethnographic interviews conducted by Haitian sociologist Stephanie Guirand for her doctoral research, the film uses a verbatim theatre approach, with its dialogue drawn directly from the words of the men interviewed. Eight men, portrayed by actors, are brought together in an imagined circle where they share deeply personal experiences of searching for, securing, and maintaining a place to call home. Directed by Corinne Spencer, with co-directors Gift Tapiwa Marovatsanga and Joy Wrolson, Where Do Black Men Live? transforms research and lived testimony into an intimate exploration of housing insecurity, systemic racism, resilience, and the fundamental question of who gets to feel secure and at home.
movies.director: Corinne Spencer, Gift Tapiwa Marovatsanga, Joy Wrolson

movies.title: The Undiscovered Country
movies.overview: In the wake of a college student's unexplained disappearance, her classmates struggle to make sense of her absence, a mosaic of overlapping memories, fragmented conversations, and shifting perspectives begins to reveal the complex truths they have concealed from one another, and from themselves.

movies.title: My Brother's Wedding
movies.overview: A young African-American man, living in Los Angeles without direction in his life, reluctantly agrees to be the best man for his brother, an upwardly mobile lawyer.

movies.title: Anak Danau
movies.overview: Her mother was gone, a void in her heart. But a tiny fish, a gift from her father, filled it with hope. Until one fateful morning, when the fish was nowhere to be found.

movies.title: Nurse: Empathy Heals
movies.overview: While people may think they know what nurses do, this documentary reveals the emotional challenges nurses face on a daily basis when caring for patients. These are nurses’ stories about compassion and empathy, the grief that doesn’t disappear, and the catharsis that comes from being heard. Through these personal stories, revealing the moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy, and fierce love that shape every act of care, the film celebrates nurses as the heroes they truly are.

movies.title: Home
movies.overview: In "Home", a contained, experimental short film, a lonely and paranoid Indonesian expat is forced to look inward while rehearsing an acting monologue that is too close to home - or lack thereof.

movies.title: There's A Roach Inside
movies.overview: A school principal is assaulted by surreal happenings.

movies.title: Judge

movies.director: Kevin Jerome Everson, Justin Randolph Thompson

movies.title: MUNCH
movies.overview: When The Nice Guy Finally Gets The Girl…

movies.title: In Her You'll Find Sanctuary
movies.overview: After the arrival of a nun with mystical visions, Sister Miriam becomes envious of her rival's sudden notoriety and begins falsifying miracles in a grotesque game of spiritual cat-and-mouse.

movies.title: Transylvania Tapes
movies.overview: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

movies.title: The Miracle of the Second Chance
movies.overview: Based on a 2022 book by a 12 year old black girl The Miracle of the Second Chance is a soulful drama about family, tradition, and the supernatural bonds that tie us together. The story begins in a vibrant village, where young Kristine learns the heart of her culture from her mother. After mastering the family kitchen and teaching her older sisters the art of cooking rice and beans, Kristine grows into a determined woman.  Her journey leads her from the village to a bustling nail salon, but her life takes a dramatic turn when her father passes away. After stepping up to take over his work, a miracle occurs: he returns to life, forever changing Kristine’s world. Years later, Kristine is a mother to two children, Lightning and Taffeta, and is married to Cled. To honor her roots, she brings her new family back to her hometown to reunite with her parents and sisters. It is a powerful "full circle" journey that ends in the beautiful peace of a normal, happy life.

movies.title: The Angel in the Death Cell
movies.overview: Based on a recently rediscovered play about a Black youth condemned to death by state execution, who is visited by an angel in his prison cell.

movies.title: Shadow in the Desert
movies.overview: An unknown creature haunts a young woman struggling with addiction after she steals a relic tainted with sinister energy.

movies.title: Beware of Dog
movies.overview: After calling a number she finds on a bathroom wall, a young woman's search for intimacy leads her down a highway of strange desire.

movies.title: Promettimi
movies.overview: “Promettimi” is a spell-like dialogue that imagines and invokes a queer future, navigating desire, reality, and collective transformation.

movies.title: CAMPEÓN
movies.overview: Emma's life violently unravels as she is both the obsession of a narcissistic addict, and the fault line between identical brothers.

movies.title: UNTIL NEXT TIME
movies.overview: After his fiancée's death, an emotionally unstable man is approached by a mysterious man who offers him a second chance to bring back what was lost at a deadly cost.

movies.title: Loretta Robinson:An American Dream
movies.overview: Joh'Vonnie Monroe:An American Dream is a film of how Joh'Vonnie Monroe got started,what achievements and records she has shattered and the barriers she broke for all black girls and woman to play The Good Witch Of The South she first gained the role in the film The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's on TMDB for this she has received praise for her performance as the iconic chachter even being called The Next EGOT and being compared to Billie Burke. Her debut music album Joh'Vonnie Monroe Introduces The Good Witch Of the South Features as the film's soundtrack.

movies.title: A Fragile Paradise
movies.overview: As storms intensify and the future of Fire Island grows uncertain, those who care for the island reveal what it means to protect a place they love that may not last.

movies.title: The Way Out
movies.overview: The Way Out drops you right into the action across the globe, from heavy Alaskan spine lines to local backyard laps in Whistler. It represents a path toward total freedom, whether tracking Hoji, Chris Rubens, and Mark Abma across the iconic Swiss Alps, or capturing breakout skier Lucy Leishman storming through Japan’s deep powder with three legendary freeskiers. The verdict is simple: the soul of skiing isn’t dead. It’s alive and well, wherever the snow is falling.

movies.title: The Last Chapter
movies.overview: A group of friends reunites for a long-overdue visit at the home of an old college classmate, now an eccentric, bestselling author and collector. What begins as a seemingly innocent reunion takes an unexpected turn as the day unfolds, revealing that their host has brought them together to confront the past and settle some unfinished business rooted in revenge.

movies.title: Invite the Devil to Come and Play
movies.overview: Oliver is an experimental musician struggling for recognition between his duties at home and at work. Spending more and more time on his strange music, he seems to have discovered an unexpected listener, one who may have a devilish motive.

movies.title: One of One
movies.overview: Milo "Miles" Williams, a rising fashion designer fighting to be seen, meets Vee — a magnetic, enigmatic presence who pushes him to turn his pain into something unforgettable. As success demands reinvention, he must decide how much of himself to sacrifice to become "one of one."

movies.title: Crossing The Rhineland
movies.overview: After a large attack on an American base in the Rhineland, Germany, SS Officer Heinrich Louzer is sent and makes it his main duty to capture and kill the ones who got away.

movies.title: Concessions
movies.overview: As the Royal Alamo Cinema closes its doors for good, jaded staff, eccentric patrons, and an unhinged manager stumble through one last night at the movies—grappling with busted dreams, bad popcorn, and hard goodbyes.

movies.title: Diaspora Power
movies.overview: Inspired by the stories of Haitian women and men who arrived in Quebec during the 1960s and 1970s, Diaspora Power, directed by Joseph Hillel, traces a generation navigating exile, migration, and the challenges of building a new home.  Through intimate personal stories, the documentary explores the realities of integration and systemic racism alongside the solidarity, community networks, and cultural connections that sustained Haitian immigrants as they established new lives in Quebec. Together, these individual experiences form a collective portrait of a diaspora determined to maintain its roots while becoming an integral part of Quebec society.  Diaspora Power is both an act of remembrance and transmission, honoring the people whose lives, labor, and resilience helped shape the social and cultural fabric of contemporary Quebec.

movies.title: The Mis-Summoning
movies.overview: Lucy, a young college student who wants to speak with her late brother. When she tries to summon him back for one night, things don't go exactly how they plan to.

movies.title: Suki Waterhouse: Austin City Limits
movies.overview: Suki Waterhouse’s set at Austin City Limits on October 3rd 2026

movies.title: Devices
movies.overview: With his wife gone for the night, a new father's first solo parenting venture becomes a nightmare.

movies.title: The Doll Walk
movies.overview: When the government attempts to erase trans identities, a group of trans women takes to the streets of New York City, demanding a future where trans people can exist on their own terms.

movies.title: Pension Patta
movies.overview: After his father’s death, Rajan and his mother, Chalu, struggle to claim his pension and repay his debts. A search for a missing name leads Rajan on a journey that transforms him from a greedy young man into a generous one.

movies.title: Peripheries
movies.overview: Multidisciplinary artist David Hartt (Canadian, born 1967) transforms John Vanderlyn's immersive historical painting, Panoramic View of the Palace and Gardens of Versailles (1818–19), into a dynamic contemporary installation, offering viewers the opportunity to explore questions of place and perspective.

movies.title: Dream vol 2. «A strolling seagull»
movies.overview: Part II of the "Dream" duology. He opens a book and falls asleep. What he sees is not a nightmare. It's a walk to the sea. Two seagulls. And feelings they never had before.

movies.title: Tashiro
movies.overview: A documentary about Tashiro Island in Japan - also known as “Cat Island” - and the cat photographer who documents them.

movies.title: Clayhead
movies.overview: An aging forensic facial reconstruction artist – tasked with approximating the faces of unidentified remains – creates a model of their own face.

movies.title: Cemeuble
movies.overview: The limitation of using a single frame as the rhythmic element of the film.  The journey of a shape in a geometric landscape. Telling another story using material found, the account of a rather chaotic journey. Fragments of beginnings, collages of frames, films found, all of which is put on a 35mm film. The images echo the crackling of magnetic tapes.  The images of a tank are shot to a strange rhythm, generated by a repetitive hammering sound. Weaves of a fragmented narrative of a collective history.  Music and images mixed together in a dance which links the sky to the earth and the earth to the sky. The overlapping of images, found and stuck, link us to a still vibrant history.

movies.title: Cosmicat
movies.overview: Cosmicat reveals a long-hidden truth: cats were actually aliens sent to conquer Earth. When their planet falls into an ice age, they turn to the Blue Planet for survival. Commander Nyaro arrives in ancient Egypt and boldly demands the Pharaoh's immediate surrender. But events take an unexpected turn when humans begin to revere her as a divine figure, giving rise to the myth of Bastet, the Egyptian cat goddess.

movies.title: Terrestrial
movies.overview: A reunion weekend spirals out of control for four college friends when the host - a science fiction writer on the verge of newfound success - fights to maintain his sense of reality in the face of sudden, uncanny dangers.

movies.title: Horror Insurance
movies.overview: A homeowner is approached by a door-to-door insurance saleswoman, offering Horror Insurance. When the homeowner refuses, the salesperson calls on her colleagues to gently persuade the homeowner into a sale.

movies.title: Enter the Television
movies.overview: From Tom Seymour creator of the VHS Massacre Trilogy. Enter the Television is a feature-length documentary exploring the dark corners of television from obscure commercials to unconventional cable programming. It examines the evolution of media through an underground lens, revealing how independent voices survive within systems controlled by powerful media corporations.

movies.title: In the Trench
movies.overview: A soldier lives in a small cloud of fear.

movies.title: No Place Like Home
movies.overview: Housing is a human right. Why should people go through so much trouble for a right that everyone deserves? Everyone should have access to affordable housing. As it stands in New York City, housing has become a commodity for the profit of few. No Place Like Home is a documentary that explores this issue and hopes to get people thinking about possible solutions to this problem.

movies.title: Last Night at the Alamo
movies.overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

movies.title: Giants of the Valley
movies.overview: In the rolling hills of Yorkshire, England, live a family with 16 dogs, including the world's largest pack of Irish Wolfhounds.

movies.title: Peru is a place to die
movies.overview: Using footage filmed in Peru in 1950 by a foreigner, Víctor writes a letter to his son to question the country he will inherit: among heartbeats and ruins, he searches for a hope that still endures amid disillusionment.

movies.title: The Myth of Sisyphus
movies.overview: As the world is ending and people across Los Angeles quietly vanish into blinding light, two teenagers journey to a radio tower to send a final broadcast, while a young man and his grandmother confront what it means to be the last ones left.

movies.title: One More Spin
movies.overview: A man and a woman cross paths while doing laundry, each stealing glances but exchanging few words. In their minds, the quiet between them fills with a rapid montage of imagined encounters—from instant chemistry to comedic disasters, heartfelt confessions to utterly bizarre twists. We see each version through both sets of eyes, revealing how differently two people can overthink the same moment. As the dryer stops and reality returns, they are faced with the decision to finally make a move.

movies.title: Run and Hit
movies.overview: Two boys find out how to go back in time and accidentally create a time loop.

movies.title: Girl Chief
movies.overview: A narrative set in the present time, the story follows two siblings of chiefly status in the province of Ra. The natural order of things is that the older sibling takes the role of chief when called upon. Through an unexpected turn of events and retribution of the older sibling, the role of chief ends up falling on the younger sibling, his sister. What unfolds is the struggle of identity and role acceptance within a chiefly household, the courage to own up to one's mistakes and the power of forgiveness.

movies.title: Deja Vu
movies.overview: When a solitary artist begins experiencing increasingly vivid dreams and waking memories of a woman he's never met, his search for answers leads him to another man haunted by the same impossible relationship.

movies.title: Ei
movies.overview: Rebecca escapes her abusive marriage in Aotearoa and returns home to the Cook Islands with her son, where they struggle to reintegrate with the small island culture and her familyʻs tradition of ei (floral garland) making.

movies.title: Only the Lord Will Set You Free
movies.overview: In the early 2010s, teenager Pete finds himself bound in the back of a windowless white van, a bomb strapped to his chest. As he recalls internet chats with an enigmatic girl known as MOAB_Didion, it's clear the lines between online love and ideological fantasy have collapsed into real-world danger.

movies.title: Hot Sand
movies.overview: Co-directed by Rockaway residents, Emma Hastil and Kaia Abraham, “Hot Sand” was shot over the summer of 2025 in Rockaway. It’s a dreamy little glimpse of a hot summer day in a small town, following the people who make the community so unique, yet familiar.

movies.title: Creature Fear
movies.overview: In a small Wisconsin lake town, a poverty-stricken felon contracts a novel prions disease after ingesting tainted venison. As his descent into madness intensifies, he targets a Chicago musician and a mysterious singer, whose dream of recording an album together is threatened by the felon's violent unraveling.

movies.title: Analog Eyes
movies.overview: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

movies.title: Not So Different
movies.overview: A volunteer playing with dogs at his local animal shelter notices that their different ways of responding to a game of fetch remind him of his former co-workers.

movies.title: Caught Between Lands
movies.overview: An experimental documentary featuring international college students commenting on their experiences of cultural isolation in America.

movies.title: Fire and the Thud
movies.overview: A drunken man comes up with a permanent solution for taking care of a noisy, soul-sucking, gigantic modern-day nuisance.

movies.title: Day One
movies.overview: Shapes blister and tumble across frame lines, colors splash, bleed, and vanish, machinic noise rumbles and churns. Produced using an entirely photochemical process on 35mm film, with an optical soundtrack generated photochemically, Day One is an odyssey of light and color, an exploration of the primary materials of analog filmmaking, and a miniature cosmos activated inside the cinematic apparatus.

movies.title: The Wonka of Worcester
movies.overview: A daughter inherits a century-old chocolate shop and its fading legacy

movies.title: Untitled
movies.overview: An experimental visual and audio exploration into the subconscious mind of Lazarus.

movies.title: The Kiss of Her Flesh
movies.overview: Richard has lost what little sanity he had left, instead putting all emphasis on seeking out and brutally slaying any and every woman who crosses his path. However, this time he might have met his match as his deceased wife's sister, Maria, is hellbent on putting an end to his orgiastic rampage.

movies.title: Street Cat Fighter
movies.overview: An animated film about how a dog reacts to the challenge of a street cat.

movies.title: Sepulchre
movies.overview: A man returns to his old apartment to find that even though his girlfriend left, the memories did not.

movies.title: Memories of Redwoods
movies.overview: When Anna struggles to navigate life as a young trans woman, she meets Chloe and finds in her the community and support she has been missing. After many memorable hikes together, Anna is devastated to learn that Chloe is moving away.  As they go on one last hike among the redwoods, Anna can’t bear to say goodbye. Set against a backdrop of rising anti-trans legislation across the country, Memories of Redwoods is a quiet, emotionally intimate story about trans friendship, chosen family, and hope for the future.

movies.title: Jhingedaau 2
movies.overview: As Khanalni goes missing, her two sons and their wives embark on a search to find her, uncovering unexpected challenges along the way.

movies.title: Grow
movies.overview: After his girlfriend dies, a grieving man awakens impossibly pregnant and becomes the captive of her fanatical family, who will stop at nothing to see the child born.

movies.title: Beyond Boy
movies.overview: After his ship lands on Earth, an unsuspecting farmer and his wife raise a young alien boy as one of their own.

movies.title: Invierno ST/CR
movies.overview: Set in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, “Invierno” emerges from seven years of conversations in the lineup between the film’s Swedish-born director and surfer, Jakob Daschek, with fellow wave rider, Lorenzo Wickstrom Vargas. In Costa Rica and neighboring Central American countries, “invierno,” translates to the rainy season or green season in English, lasting from May through November. The film depicts how the summer is full of tourists, and when “invierno,” begins, it’s the season for the locals.

movies.title: The Great Experiment
movies.overview: The Great Experiment is an ambitious cinematic time capsule of one of the most volatile and perplexing eras of American history; a project that serves as a historical document, non-fiction experiment and intimate observation of the changing state of American democracy and identity. A surprising time capsule of a nation grappling with its differences and diversity, and our experience and perceptions of conflict, survival and belonging.
movies.director: Stephen T. Maing, Eric Daniel Metzgar

movies.title: Love and Katsom
movies.overview: A Vanuatu-New Zealand documentary following real-life couple Kersom and Benina as they navigate modern romance and traditional kastom around their wedding.

movies.title: Giants Do Fall
movies.overview: It’s a classic David vs. Goliath scenario: in the oil and gas strongholds of Louisiana's River Parishes and Appalachia's Rust Belt, where false economic promises and industrial pollution have become the norm, fed-up residents square off against their politicians and big business, proving to be a formidable foe. Thrust into the role of accidental activists, the group exposes how racism, classism, and corruption fuel the systems around them, and channel their collective power to show that ordinary people can fight back – and that giants do fall.

movies.title: Lāhainā: Voices of Change
movies.overview: On August 8, 2024, the town of Lahaina was devastated by a massive wildfire, leaving most of the historic town in ruins. It became one of the deadliest wildfires in U.S. history, displacing thousands of residents and claiming many lives. A year later, this small, close-knit community continues to struggle with rebuilding. The disaster has revealed deeper issues, including the impacts of climate change, land management challenges, dependence on tourism, and the housing crisis. Once the capital of the Hawaiian monarchy, Lahaina holds deep ancestral ties, with families tracing their roots back multiple generations. Now, as the town starts the long process of healing.

movies.title: Heavy is the Crown
movies.overview: Heavy is the Crown follows Milwaukee community activist and violence interrupter Vaun Mayes as he works alongside individuals and neighborhoods most affected by cycles of violence, systemic neglect, and contested approaches to policing. The film examines what it means to care for a city from the inside out, foregrounding the resilience and forms of care that sustain communities from within.

movies.title: Ayahuasca Haunting: The Vine of Souls
movies.overview: A reclusive prodigy turns to the occult, brewing ayahuasca, the fabled vine of souls, and unknowingly opens a portal, unleashing an entity from another dimension.

movies.title: Comfort Food
movies.overview: After driving across the country from Oakland, Lisa lands at her mother-in-law Annie's home in Georgia. Lisa sits outside the decrepit farmhouse with an envelope she must deliver as part of her deceased husband's last wishes.

movies.title: Laundromat
movies.overview: A simple, late night laundry run turns into a waking nightmare when a young woman discovers she’s not alone and that some places shouldn’t be visited after dark.

movies.title: The Path
movies.overview: A film the follows Holly Beckham (Ngāpuhi) is on a mission to be the first Māori woman to scale Everest. She has no alpine experience, but she has survived the depths of addiction and is climbing a mountain to recovery.

movies.title: Amber
movies.overview: A young man is home alone for the night and gets some unexpected visitors.

movies.title: Never Give Up!
movies.overview: A deadly border crossing leaves a young boy alone in the desert. As exhaustion sets in, the words his mother taught him to live by return in a stranger’s voice – transforming one of the most overused phrases in American culture into an unexpected lifeline.

movies.title: A Bloody Mess
movies.overview: A true-crime documentarian and her trusty crew investigate a small-town tragedy that’s faded into memory as a national joke. As her determination to uncover the truth becomes more and more intense, her methods become less and less ethical—until they become dangerous.

movies.title: Crown or Class
movies.overview: Crown or Class is a Pan-African feature documentary that follows two young African women; one in Belgium, the other in Ghana — whose journeys into natural hair care unfold into a powerful exploration of identity, beauty, and belonging. What begins as a personal choice becomes a wider reflection on how Eurocentric beauty standards continue to shape African women’s self-worth across continents

movies.title: Bodega Cat
movies.overview: An animated film about a bodega cat who protects the store from robbers at night.

movies.title: Cat Anatomy
movies.overview: Young school children divulge their hilarious nicknames for various parts of a cat.

movies.title: Faraway Home
movies.overview: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

movies.title: A Correspondence
movies.overview: Cryptic voices and ghostly images accumulate and collide in eerie soft focus and fleeting alternations of light and shadow, as noise steadily coalesces into a signal.

movies.title: Why Did You Stop Me?
movies.overview: A night-shift officer stops a car with no plates. The driver, a strange young woman, turns the routine stop very dark. Captured on bodycam.

movies.title: Bird in Hand
movies.overview: A bride-to-be with a secret agenda returns to her hometown, using her wedding plans to manipulate everyone in her orbit.

movies.title: The Route to Cappyness
movies.overview: A filmmaker embarks on a global adventure to uncover the viral fascination of the capybara, including exploring how they have become cultural symbols of serenity in Japan.

movies.title: God's Future Soldiers
movies.overview: At God’s Future Soldiers, an intensive evangelical summer camp, a teen girl’s faith is tested when God comes to her in a dream and demands she harvest souls for the coming end times.

movies.title: Watsky x Infinity
movies.overview: "Watsky x Infinity" is the visual film for the album "x Infinity". The 2016 visual album by rapper and poet George Watsky features 18 interconnected music videos for each song on his album of the same name.

movies.title: The Red Chair
movies.overview: A modern legend unfolds when a lone chair appears on the shore, drawing the attention of a curious and watchful community. Through shifting hands and acts of care, the chair becomes woven into the folklore of the shore—until the day it disappears, leaving behind only the unseen forces that shaped its myth.

movies.title: Seeker
movies.overview: A man suddenly appears in an empty parking garage with no memory of how he got there. Once he gathers himself, it dawns upon him that he's unable to leave this never-ending labyrinth. The key to escape, finding his missing shoe that was gifted to him many years ago.

movies.title: The Lone Piper
movies.overview: In the midst of the Seven Years' War, a company of hardened soldiers force their young bagpipe player into battle, only to discover that their enemy is not what they expected.

movies.title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
movies.overview: A four part ambiguation of "weirdness" in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

movies.title: A Compilation Of Shots I Consider To Be Beautiful
movies.overview: "Thought these were pretty cool." - QV

movies.title: Behuli
movies.overview: An emotional family drama about a young woman who lacks the support of her family. She dreams of finding a loving husband who will cherish her, help her build a beautiful life, and give her the freedom to live on her own terms.

movies.title: Where the Fear Ends
movies.overview: In 1976 a small group of women in Montgomery County, PA sat together around a kitchen table to discuss the Women’s Movement. They were aware of women wanting to enter the workforce, go to college, and create ways to balance all of it with their roles as wives and mothers. They thought it might be a good idea to set up a women’s resource group and have a place that women could come to discuss ideas and receive support. Then the hotline started ringing. Volunteers answered the calls. And the calls kept coming. The majority of calls were from women sharing that they were being abused by their partners and they needed help. The Volunteers were shocked and sprang into action to build an organization that addressed the needs of domestic violence victims.  Fifty years later the Women's Center of Montgomery County has grown into a thriving organization with seven offices and more than 150 Volunteers and one of the most effective domestic violence organizations in the country.

movies.title: The Catcher
movies.overview: Robin, a lonely young man, works for the government as a catcher of invisible birds. One day he defies his orders and makes one dangerous choice.

movies.title: Deuce Purgatory
movies.overview: When the players of a mixed doubles tennis match get stuck at 40-40 for seemingly an eternity, underdog Shelly Shlop realizes that to win the match, she must find her self-worth.

movies.title: Mouse
movies.overview: When a lonely petty thief begins a correspondence with the woman of his dreams, two competing fantasies collide in an unexpectedly human story about loneliness, class, and the desperate need to belong.

movies.title: Farewell, Leah Chanel
movies.overview: Four inversions of an increasingly melancholic relationship

movies.title: Ka Pō Lōʻihi
movies.overview: Ka pō lōʻihi is an experimental short film about Kekai, a native Hawaiian born into a broken family where violence, drug abuse, and corruption rob him of his innocence. When his single mother passes away, Kekai is left to his own devices and struggles to break free of the generational curse of systemic drug abuse and incarceration. Kekai, a defeated and will-stricken adult, is forced to face his childhood trauma alone in his cell. Will Kekai’s ignorance prevent his journey through the vast darkness to Ho’oponopono?

movies.title: Nine Days of Sadness
movies.overview: An isolated gamer accidentally discovers an analog-style game that promises deep human connection with an anonymous player on the other end of the screen --- only to discover the horrors the game is built on.

movies.title: In The Weeds
movies.overview: An obsessive husband discovers an unkillable weed that begins to threaten his suburban and so-called "perfect life."

movies.title: Before Dawn
movies.overview: A spacious apartment on the third floor is the only one with the lights on. Clinking glasses, chatter, and laughter. It’s a classmate reunion. They are going to hang till dawn, just as they did on their prom night. And it all goes well until people start disappearing without leaving a trace.

movies.title: Web Extraction
movies.overview: Arachnophobia is a curious phenomenon.... A research subject reveals his horrifying altered form during a rescue attempt...

movies.title: Screamplay
movies.overview: A talented writer, Edgar Allen, arrives in Hollywood with big dreams but is quickly pulled into a world of madness and depravity. A detective investigating a series of murders discovers that they are similar to the murders that occur in the new script by Edgar. Who will survive and what parts will be left for them?

movies.title: Mimi The Mime
movies.overview: A homeless mime and a struggling clown fight over the attention of a crowd on a NYC sidewalk.  When their fight draws more attention and money than their performances ever could, they  realize they struck gold. Broke, desperate and out of options, the pair transform their slapstick  routines into an underground bare-knuckle sensation called ‘Mime vs Clown’.

movies.title: Taipei Cat Dreams of Sicily
movies.overview: A cat’s rumination on other cats, other places.

movies.title: Journey
movies.overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

movies.title: Head in the Grave
movies.overview: A woman may or may not see her deceased father alive again.

movies.title: The House
movies.overview: A teenager calls his friend over to talk about a reoccurring dream he has about a house.

movies.title: Like a Monster: a video poem in 5 parts
movies.overview: Vintage filmstrips and projectors were widely used in classrooms during the 1960s and 1970s as educational tools. A filmstrip is a 35mm roll of still images that advances manually through a projector, often accompanied by recorded narration on cassette tape. Unlike digital video, filmstrips do not move continuously; the turning of a knob allows for pauses and reflection. Viewers are cued to advance the frames by a beep in the audio, creating a rhythm that emphasizes attention and shared experience. The project draws inspiration from Dada cut-up poems, in which clipped words from printed materials were rearranged to generate spontaneous and unexpected meanings.

movies.title: De Gaulle: Résistance

movies.title: The Crow

movies.title: Being Heumann

movies.title: How to Rob a Bank

movies.title: I Play Rocky

movies.title: Bitter Christmas

movies.title: Avedon

By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

movies.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
movies.overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

collection.name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: The Movie Collection

movies.title: Steps
movies.overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

movies.title: ENE Repeat
movies.overview: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

movies.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
movies.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

collection.name: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood Collection

movies.title: Werwulf
movies.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

movies.title: Tangles
movies.overview: When Alzheimer's disease begins to strip away her mother's vibrant personality, a headstrong young woman is forced to return to her oddball family in the conservative small town she recently fled in order to care for her. She quickly realizes she must accept the cruel and warped reality of the disease, and the imperfect beauty of her family, in order to become the daughter they need.

movies.title: Focker-in-Law
movies.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

movies.title: Bunker
movies.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

movies.title: Elsinore
movies.overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

movies.title: Coward
movies.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by tenderness, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

movies.title: Mr. Irrelevant
movies.overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

movies.title: Ray Gunn
movies.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

movies.title: La Gradiva
movies.overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

movies.title: Ink
movies.overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

movies.title: Flavia
movies.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

movies.title: Look Back
movies.overview: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

movies.title: Iron Boy
movies.overview: In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

movies.title: November 1963
movies.overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

movies.title: Clarissa
movies.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

movies.title: Rose
movies.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

movies.title: Behemoth!
movies.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

movies.title: Violent Night 2
movies.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

movies.title: Above the Below
movies.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

movies.title: Children of Blood and Bone
movies.overview: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

movies.title: Artificial
movies.overview: The story of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, centred on his controversial firing and re-hiring in November 2023, a movement led by co-founder Ilya Sutskever.

movies.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
movies.overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

movies.title: Animal Friends
movies.overview: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

movies.title: King
movies.overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

movies.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
movies.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

movies.title: The Liberation
movies.overview: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

movies.title: Best Pancakes in the County
movies.overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

movies.title: River
movies.overview: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

movies.title: 14th
movies.overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

movies.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
movies.overview: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

movies.title: The Gallerist
movies.overview: A desperate gallerist conspires to sell a dead body at Art Basel Miami.

movies.title: A Long Winter
movies.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

movies.title: Tender Loving Care
movies.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

movies.title: Air Bud Returns
movies.overview: 12-year-old Jacob is an aspiring basketball player coping with the recent loss of his father. After he and his mother move to his dad’s childhood home in Fernfield, Jacob discovers a VHS tape of his old man playing basketball on the same court as a hoops-shooting golden retriever. Soon, Jacob begins his own adventure with a neglected golden retriever that he names Buddy.

movies.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
movies.overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

movies.title: Cloud Girl
movies.overview: The adventures of a young girl named Providence, who is entrusted with a magic quill that makes everything she writes come true. Faced with this incredible power, she has to choose between living her dreams and saving the world.

movies.title: The Friend's House is Here
movies.overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

movies.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
movies.overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

movies.title: In Waves
movies.overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

movies.title: Lilo & Scratch
movies.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

movies.title: FING!
movies.overview: No description yet.

movies.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
movies.overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

movies.title: Starlight
movies.overview: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

movies.title: Pendulum
movies.overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

movies.title: The Third Parent
movies.overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

movies.title: Hershey
movies.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company.  Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s orphans.

movies.title: wyrdo
movies.overview: A Christmas dinner party is interrupted by an uninvited guest.

movies.title: Hurricanna
movies.overview: In an attempt to save Anna Nicole Smith's life, her devoted therapist, Khristine embarks on a 36-hour odyssey in which she unknowingly delivers the fatal blow.

movies.title: The Test
movies.overview: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.

movies.title: Honeymoon
movies.overview: When two strangers meet at a seemingly ordinary event, their lives could change forever, as they step into a fairytale romance, with the fragility of their blind love looming above them.

movies.title: Apophis 2029
movies.overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

movies.title: Our House
movies.overview: Charls Carroll stars as a Revolutionary War soldier washed ashore from the past and resurrected.
