movies.overview: Plot unknown.

movies.title: Duped (The Jezbel Experience)
movies.overview: Alexandria Wright meets Elijah Martinez and the demonic journey begins. Elijah Martinez finds himself ensnared in a romantic involvement with Alexandria Wright, an unfaithful Covert Narcissist. She convinces him they are soulmates and they take a vow before God for His blessing with the penalty of betrayal being death. After years pass, Alexandria forgets the vows and begins cheating behind Elijah's back. Just a week before Christmas, she abruptly betrays him. To his astonishment, she swiftly transitions to a new relationship, bringing with her the unsettling secret of transmitting an incurable sexually transmitted disease to her new partner. Then came Karma. Her victims arrive to spit on her dirty grave as her demise finally arrives.

movies.title: Rocky Wake
movies.overview: Elise, long estranged from her mother Megan, visits her as she lies on her deathbed. Her mother recounts a life-changing moment from the early 80s, her father’s devastating diagnosis and a serial killer stalking the town. Elise reconstructs her mother’s memories, drawing them closer as the night unfolds.

movies.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
movies.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

movies.title: Finding Faith
movies.overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith Tour via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

movies.title: Samo Lives
movies.overview: A vibrant portrait of Jean-Michel Basquiat, the NYC artist who revolutionized 1980s art. From street graffiti to gallery stardom, his bold Neo-expressionist works left an indelible mark on the art world and beyond.

movies.title: Starlight & You
movies.overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

movies.title: The Pools
movies.overview: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

movies.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
movies.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

movies.title: Rose Hobart 2
movies.overview: Rose Hobart haunts the cinema.

movies.title: We're So Bad
movies.overview: A group of clueless boys embark on a chaotic quest to retrieve their broken drone in this outrageous fan-made animated parody.

movies.title: Animals
movies.overview: Still trapped in a doomsday bunker the scientist continues his mission to narrate over footage of the natural world, hoping if animals ever return to this planet they will be cherished.

movies.title: The Raven of Baltimore City
movies.overview: After a deadly encounter with a purse snatcher, a comic-book-obsessed man  sets out to become a masked superhero, putting himself on course to discover his inner villain in this darkly comic crime film.

movies.title: Limerence
movies.overview: Nora is an eccentric young woman with a debilitating infatuation with her newspaper delivery man — a man she has never even dared to speak to... Things begin to change when one fateful night, he appears to her in a dreamlike vision where he promises her everything she has ever longed for. Convinced this is her chance at true love, Nora decides to take a leap of faith in pursuit of her prince charming’s undivided affection.

movies.title: Captain Bonanza!
movies.overview: Daring hero Captain Bonanza -- né Hudson Hill -- uncovers a sinister plot surrounding three magic idols in the mystic Hudson Valley. But this scheme is far greater, and far deadlier, than he ever could have imagined.

movies.title: Precipice
movies.overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

movies.title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
movies.overview: After tragedy shatters her life, professional ballerina Sua allows the demon Nara to possess her—transforming her body, movement and rage into a deadly weapon.

movies.title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii
movies.overview: Plot to be announced.

movies.title: Bleeders
movies.overview: A drug deal with a vampire goes horribly wrong.

movies.title: 3xHelô
movies.overview: A girl just broke up with her boyfriend and needs to talk.

movies.title: UK Holiday
movies.overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

movies.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
movies.overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

movies.title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
movies.overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

movies.title: Ash and Crayons
movies.overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

movies.title: What We Owe to Each Other
movies.overview: Plot unknown.

movies.overview: After a nervous breakdown, a young office assistant flees to his parents' house in Arizona and hires an escort to take care of him.

movies.overview: Plot unknown.

movies.title: The Selling Stage
movies.overview: At the end of a twenty-five-year career, LuFisto confronts the cost of chasing a dream that asked for everything and gave back less than promised.

movies.title: KITTY, KITTY!
movies.overview: An upcoming indie horror film based on Dr. Seuss ' The Cat in the Hat.

movies.title: Live at Parish Park
movies.overview: On a cool autumn day in a park in Orleans, Massachusetts, local busking fixture Kevin “Coyote” Linnehan gathers friends, acquaintances, and passing strangers to sing and tell stories. Between original songs and covers of old favorites, Kevin revisits his colorful past in the music and arts worlds of the 1970s and ’80s—from “the heart of Boston” to New York and Hollywood. His stories feature familiar names from classic rock lore: Asa Brebner, Andy Pratt, Jonathan Richman, Robin Lane, and Andy Summers. There at Kevin’s invitation is Carol, a photographer and friend from his New York days whom he hasn’t seen in years. The two recall shared adventures, former flames, and youthful ambitions. Kevin also explains how caring for his aging parents brought him to the Cape decades ago—and kept him there. Live at Parish Park is a funny, tender portrait of an artist with plenty to sing about—and an audience that takes neither his stories nor his set list lying down.

movies.title: Parallel
movies.overview: An eleven-year-old boy discovers a secret project that completely shatters his understanding of reality. He must race to uncover the truth before the forces behind the operation alter his life forever.

movies.title: Mr. Penguin: The Movie
movies.overview: When unexplained events begin to occur, a hidden presence reveals itself. Silent, watchful, and growing closer—Mr. Penguin is no longer just a mystery.

movies.title: Prodigal Son
movies.overview: Aaron "Amadeus" Overlake is a visionary filmmaker revered for his genius but plagued by his own demons—a volatile alcoholic whose life is consumed by anger, controversy, and from a bitter heartbreak. As tabloids revel in his self-destruction, Aaron’s only anchor is his best friend, Santiago "Baron" Gonzalez, a charismatic actor fresh out of rehab, fighting to rebuild his career.  Bound by shared struggles and a tangled history, Aaron and Santiago navigate the toxic undercurrents of fame and friendship. As Aaron embarks on his next masterpiece, his chaotic life threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

movies.title: Without a Trace
movies.overview: A criminal on the run attempts to break into a house for hiding. He realizes his escape will be far more difficult than originally planned.

movies.title: Vive le Punk
movies.overview: 50 years after the British Punk explosion, this documentary follows four bands that are still active today (Sham 69, 999, Ruts DC and The Boys) and features interviews with Charlie Harper, Joe Corre, Dr. John Cooper Clarke, Gaye Advert and other Punk Rock luminaries in search for the meaning of Punk and the relevance of its message today.  With rare archival footage, explosive live performances, and an unflinching look at the punk ethos in today’s world, this film is not just a retrospective—In a world that mirrors the one Punk once railed against, is the message still relevant—or has it been consumed by commercialism?. This film should appeal to every generation of rebels, misfits, and outsiders. Punk may have started as anarchy in the streets, but it’s far from finished. Vive le Punk!

movies.title: Narayan Pustika 2 - Endless
movies.overview: This movie is the second part of the Narayana Pustika trilogy. In which there is a description of the troubles arising from the opening of the unimaginable door revealed by the great sages.

movies.title: Jean

movies.title: As Sisters in Zion
movies.overview: This film depicts the story of two Latter-day Saint sister missionaries serving in the Oregon Portland Mission, learning about life and how to help other people.

movies.title: Errand Guy
movies.overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.
